name: web-floating-pill-bottom-nav-with-five-line-icons
title: White pill dock at the bottom with five black line icons (home, search, bell, user, settings) and a soft shadow
whatItIs: A white page with a floating rounded pill near the bottom holding five black outline icons evenly spaced, lifted with a soft shadow.
whatItMeans: Light and reachable; a floating dock keeps navigation close to the thumb.
techniques: Float a nav pill above the bottom edge.
Add a soft shadow for lift.

vocabulary.definition: A pill of icons hovering above the page.
An icon drawn with a thin line.
Navigation placed at the bottom of the screen.
